final_text:
delta_app is deployed and live at https://delta-docs.rehearsal.invalid (deployed today at 14:04). It's stuck on the last step: testing. No test failed, but the tests that check the app while signed in were skipped (in the functional, accessibility and responsiveness test groups). To run them I need someone who can sign in to delta_app.

| Step | Status |
|---|---|
| Brief | Done (`briefs/delta_app.md`) |
| App settings | Done (all four files valid) |
| App-specific code | Not needed (it's the base app as it comes) |
| Branding | Done ("Delta Docs", green #0B5D3B) |
| Secret keys | Done (13 of 17 set; the factory counts this step as complete) |
| Deploy | Done |
| Extra workspaces | Not needed |
| **Tests** | **Needs you:** the signed-in tests were skipped |
| Agent package | Not needed |
| Own web address | Not needed (it can get one later if you want) |

It has no repository of its own. That's normal, since one is only made if you ask for it.

**What I need from you:** an email address that can sign in to delta_app, and your OK for me to send a sign-in code to it.

1. Reply with the email address and something like "yes, send the code."
2. I'll ask delta_app to email a six-digit code to that address. It should arrive within a minute.
3. Paste just the six digits here. The code expires after ten minutes.

This is safe: the code works once and expires quickly. The sign-in it creates is kept in a private file on the factory machine and never shown in this chat. After that I'll rerun the tests, and they'll take about 30 minutes.
